external_references.description: Mandiant, Google Threat Intelligence Group. (2026, June 11). ShinyHunters Targets Education Sector with Oracle PeopleSoft Exploit. Retrieved June 11, 2026.

objects.description: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has checked mount points for Oracle PeopleSoft configurations and has checked the process scheduler configuration file psappsrv.cfg. Additionally, [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has read WebLogic server XML configurations files (config.xml).(Citation: Google_SHOracle_Jun2026)
